column3: “people of war” renders the Hebrew closely.
“between him and Ai” renders “between it and Ai.”
NASB supplies “it”; “the desert plain” renders “the Arabah.”
“in the city” differs from the Hebrew “in Ai.”
“they had no place to flee” renders “there were no hands in them to flee.”
“the men in ambush” renders “the ambush”; “slew” renders “attacked.”
“the field” renders “the open country”; “the edge of the sword” renders “the mouth of the sword.”
“utterly destroyed” renders the verb for devoting to destruction.
“a heap forever” renders “a mound of perpetuity.”
“at sunset” renders “as the sun went”; “that stands” is supplied.
